event.distribution_pattern: distributed in CA, OR, and WA

products.product_description: Ariels OM Grown Granola. Product number GR200, net wt. 5 lb., packaged in bulk bag inside plastic bucket. Product number GR201, net wt.15 lb., packaged in bulk bag inside plastic bucket. Product number BAG-GR200, net wt. 8 oz., packaged in cellophane bag with cardstock label. Product number SBAG-GR200, net wt. 4 oz., packaged in cellophane bag with cardstock label.
products.code_info: 5lb and 15lb bulk containers have a manufacturing date (mm/dd/yy) stamped on label or bucket: 070315 through 100616, or a Julian date of 16294 through 16331. 4 oz and 8 oz packages have a Julian code of 15184 through 16331.
products.reason_for_recall: Ariels Om Grown Granola is recalled because it was contaminated with wheat seed.
